summary: Police announced four additional arrests/suspect detentions in investigations of alleged Jewish extremist violence, including an IDF conscript and suspects tied generally to nationalist violence/arson
evidence_media: Police-announcement reporting only; no exact incident media attached.
resolution_notes: Times of Israel reports the police announcement. The update does not identify a specific underlying incident for most suspects, so it is not promoted or attached to a canonical violence event. Arrest/suspicion is not treated as guilt. The first arrest directly tied to the Aug. 29 Qusra raid is already preserved under ILPV-2026-0059.
